effects.text: Artık ücret almanın vakti. Fiyatı belirle.
effects.text_en: Time to start charging. Set the price.

tr.title: Fiyat meselesi
tr.subtitle: Mutfak masası
tr.body:
Ürün yayında; deneyenler var.

Telefon çalıyor, arayan Frank.

"Kullanıcılar ürüne para vermek için can atmıyor ama bir noktada ücret almaya başlasak iyi olur."

en.title: About the price
en.subtitle: Kitchen table
en.body:
The product is live. People are trying it.

The phone rings. It's Frank.

"Nobody's rushing to pay for it, but at some point we need to start charging."
en.expire_note: The question of price closed without being opened.

_repair_note: the card that says "we should start charging at some point" neither opened the paid tier nor navigated anywhere; and its trigger read a stamp the engine store has never heard of
_r8a_note: A non-critical interrupt is demotable (§13.2), and a demoted card lands on the desk with a clock — which is the only reason paper is a safe floor for I4. So it carries the paper trio even though it usually renders as an interrupt.
_port_note: Tagged `critical` — which in this engine means the sweep proposes it, not the weighted pool. It is a `one_shot` with a deterministic condition (the product is live) and it is a gateway beat, not pool colour; leaving it to a draw meant some runs simply never got it, with nothing to point at.
